data.source: AMIS belt median via Kissan Cares

data.title: AMIS maize 24 Nov: belt median Rs6,438 per 100 kg with all nine belt mandis reporting
data.summary: Belt median Rs6,438 per 100 kg (Rs2,575 per 40 kg) on 24 Nov, level with Rs6,431 on 23 Nov, as Burewala reported at Rs6,188; Arifwala rose to Rs6,500, Kamalia eased to Rs6,750 and Sahiwal stayed lowest at Rs4,650. Other Punjab mandis held at a Rs7,375 median on eight mandis.

data.note: Dec-26 settled $353.00 on 24 Nov, +$7.30, a five-week high after NOPA showed a low meal yield; Jan-27 traded $349.10 overnight. Weekly change shown is for the week to 20 Nov. Dec expires 14 Dec.
Dec-26 closed $4.34 on 24 Nov, −¼¢; March +½¢ to $4.50¼. US harvest 94% done at 22 Nov. Weekly change shown is for the week to 20 Nov.

Dec-26 settled 59.36¢ on 23 Nov, −45 points from 20 Nov; ADMIS reports a further fall of more than 1¢ on 24 Nov to a nine-month low (settle not yet confirmed). Weekly change shown is for the week to 20 Nov.

data.act: Keep buying dry new-crop in weekly lots, starting with Sahiwal (Rs46.5/kg for a fourth report, check moisture on such a low price), then Burewala (Rs61.9/kg), Pakpattan (Rs63.5/kg), Vehari (Rs63.8/kg) and Mailsi (Rs64.4/kg); Arifwala and Chichawatni are Rs65.0/kg, Kamalia Rs67.5/kg and Okara Rs74.8/kg. Reject lots above 14% moisture or failing aflatoxin.
data.why: The belt median was Rs64.4/kg on 24 Nov with all nine belt mandis reporting (Burewala at Rs61.9/kg), level with Rs64.3/kg on 23 Nov; it is 7.3% above 24 Oct (Rs60.0/kg), 18.2% below a year ago (Rs78.8/kg on 24 Nov 2025) and at 36% of its 52-week range (Rs54.4–82.5/kg). Other Punjab mandis held at Rs73.8/kg, so the belt stays the cheapest source as autumn-crop arrivals peak in Nov–Dec.

data.refreshNote: AMIS maize for 24 Nov added (belt median Rs6,438 per 100 kg on nine mandis, flat) and CBOT updated: Dec meal settled $353.00 on 24 Nov (+$7.30), Dec corn $4.34, Dec soy oil 59.36¢ for 23 Nov; wheat was already current, rice rows are generic paddy, the 24 Nov soy-oil settle and 25 Nov interbank close were not yet available, and Brownfield's closing page failed.
